errors.text_span: Графиката илюстрира корелацията между две Браунови движения при различни стойности на корелацията
errors.evidence: The figure contains three separate subplots, not a single graph. The description incorrectly refers to it as a single graph.
The description does not explicitly state that the figure illustrates the movement of two correlated Brownian motions for different correlation coefficients (ρ).
The description omits the axis labels: the x-axis represents time, and the y-axis represents the value of the processes.
The description does not mention the third subplot (ρ = 0.75) or its characteristics, including the strong correlation and synchronized movement of the lines.
The description does not specify the exact ranges of the blue and orange lines for each subplot, as detailed in the atom checklist (e.g., graph1_blue_max, graph1_blue_min, etc.).
The description does not describe the qualitative behavior of the processes, such as the weak, moderate, or strong correlation and their visual manifestations in each subplot.
The description omits the overall conclusion that increasing correlation leads to closer and more synchronized movement of the two Brownian motions.
